savedWork: Your saved documents remain in your PXA account. Changes that were not saved may need to be made again.

badRequest.title: Request could not be processed
badRequest.message: The request is incomplete, invalid, or no longer supported.

unauthenticated.title: Sign in required
unauthenticated.message: Sign in to continue to this protected area.

conflict.title: A newer change is available
conflict.message: Reload the latest version before applying your changes again.

requestTimeout.title: Request timed out
requestTimeout.message: The request did not finish in time. Check the current state before trying again.

expiredLink.title: This link has expired
expiredLink.message: Request a new link and use only the most recent message.

fileTooLarge.title: File is too large
fileTooLarge.message: Choose a smaller file or reduce its size before trying again.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.message: Wait a moment before trying again.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.message: PXA could not complete this request. Your saved work remains available.

upstreamUnavailable.title: A required service is unavailable
upstreamUnavailable.message: The application is available, but a required service did not respond correctly.

maintenance.title: Planned maintenance
maintenance.message: PXA is undergoing planned maintenance. Your stored documents are not affected.

timeout.title: The request took too long
timeout.message: The operation did not finish in time. Its status may still be available after reloading.

unsupportedBrowser.title: Browser not supported
unsupportedBrowser.message: Open PXA in a current version of a supported browser.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: The address may be incorrect, or the page may have moved.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.message: Reconnect to continue. Changes that were already saved remain available.

trialExpired.title: Your Designer trial has expired
trialExpired.message: Your documents remain in your account. An active subscription is required to continue.

entitlementDenied.title: Subscription access required
entitlementDenied.message: This capability is not included in the active subscription.

suspended.title: Account access is suspended
suspended.message: Contact your organization administrator or PXA Support before trying again.

sessionExpired.title: Your session expired
sessionExpired.message: Your work remains in your account. Sign in again to continue.

incompatibleVersion.title: Update required
incompatibleVersion.message: This Designer version is not compatible with the PXA API. Reload to get the latest version.

forbidden.title: Access not permitted
forbidden.message: Your account does not have permission to use this capability.

unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
unavailable.message: PXA is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
